about: Every successful fabric.yml run up to commit 01d5727 that ran tests/test_failures.py. Each "results" array is parsed from the "FAILURES_JSON" line that the test prints in the run's log. The test and router configs did not change across these runs, apart from adding vtysh.conf (14275d5).

results.seen_by_operator: interface operstate still 'up'; BFD peer down, then BGP session down on eth1

results.seen_by_operator: BGP session on leaf1 eth1 resets three times; the path through spine2 never moves

results.seen_by_operator: both leaf2 sessions still Established (2/2) but leaf1 has no route to 10.1.2.0/24; leaf2 advertised-routes shows nothing
